keep.instructions: Should this block be kept in a clean reader-mode view of the page's main article? Keep = it is part of the article's own body text, headings, images/figures, code, tables, quotes or footnotes. Do not keep = site navigation, ads, promotions, newsletter/subscribe or sign-in prompts, social sharing, related/recommended/more-stories links, comment sections, cookie/consent banners, author bylines, dates, tags/categories, breadcrumbs, read-time, or other page boilerplate.

criteria.true: Keep: the block is part of the article's own content
criteria.false: Do not keep: the block is navigation, promotion, metadata, comments or other page boilerplate

kind.instructions: What kind of block is this, in the context of a web page that contains an article? Judge only from what is literally in the block.

criteria.article_body: Prose paragraphs, lists or quotes that are part of the article's own text
criteria.heading: A heading or title line of the article or one of its sections
criteria.media_or_figure: An image, figure, caption, video or audio embed that belongs to the article
criteria.code_or_table: A code block, code listing, or data table that belongs to the article
criteria.footnotes_or_references: Footnotes, citations, endnotes or a references list belonging to the article
criteria.navigation_or_menu: Site navigation, menus, breadcrumbs, skip links, table of contents, pagination or previous/next links
criteria.promo_or_cta: Advertisement, promotion, newsletter or subscribe prompt, sign-in prompt, app download or other call to action
criteria.related_links_or_cards: Related, recommended, popular, trending or more-stories links and article cards
criteria.comments: A comment section, comment thread or individual user comments and their headers
criteria.byline_or_metadata: Author byline, author bio, publish date, read time, tags, categories, share counts or similar page metadata
criteria.cookie_or_consent: Cookie, privacy or consent banner or notice
criteria.other: None of the above, or not enough information to tell
